# Quicklook

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Quicklooks the provided input.

## Syntax

~~~~text
quicklook(input: <#Variable (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
quicklook(input: ShortcutInput)
~~~~
